add_preview_hint: Live preview rendered against this server's current data.
add_realtime_hint: This counter changes constantly, so a short interval is worth it.
add_style_text_hint: This counter produces {kind} rather than a number, so the style only affects %count.raw%.
add_twitch_counter_hint: The name of a counter your Twitch chat commands already update.
counters_text: Every counter Mewdeko can display, with an example of how it renders.
defaults_text: These apply to stat channels created from now on. Existing channels keep their own settings.
edit_hint: Changes save automatically. Each save renames the channel, which Discord limits to two per 10 minutes.
list_empty_text: Add a voice channel to display live server stats
mechanism_auto_blurb: Renames while the per-channel budget allows it and only falls back to recreating when you have asked for a faster refresh than a rename can deliver.
mechanism_recreate_blurb: Recreates the channel each update using the far more permissive guild channel bucket, so it can refresh every minute.
mechanism_recreate_caution: The channel ID changes on every update and each refresh writes two audit log entries.
mechanism_rename_blurb: Edits the existing channel name. The channel keeps its ID, position and permissions.
mechanism_rename_caution: Discord allows two name edits per 10 minutes per channel, so this cannot refresh faster than every 5 minutes.
notify_add_failed: Failed to add. That channel may already be a stat channel.
notify_save_failed: Couldn't save stat channel settings. Use Retry to try again.
page_subtitle: Voice channels displaying live server statistics
remove_message: Remove the stat channel "{name}"? The voice channel itself is left in place.
styles_text: How each style renders the number 1,234 against a target of 2,000.
